definition: 기존 AI matcher가 추출한 비중복 AI 관련 문장의 firm-year별 개수이다. 전체 표본 평균은 미공시 firm-year의 0을 포함한다.

preprocessing: Cleaned analysis text; overlapping term matches are resolved by existing matcher.

interpretation: Textual AI communication intensity, not adoption.
limitation: Counts depend on dictionary coverage, sentence extraction and reporting style.

sentence_rule: Eligible analysis sentences from existing extraction pipeline
missing_rule: Missing when source denominator is unavailable.
zero_rule: Zero AI sentences yield zero when denominator is positive.
validation_rule: Non-negative and within [0, 1] when non-missing.
interpretation: Relative AI sentence intensity.
limitation: Sensitive to section extraction and total sentence denominator.
